concept_uz: Badargʻa qilinganlar oʻqdagi teshiklarda oʻz xonligini quradi: Ildiz-Ikki — xon, Pi — vazir, savdogar E esa murakkab foiz bilan boyiydi — lekin pul hech qachon 2,72 baravarga yetmaydi. Elchi Pi qirol huzuriga keladi: «Biz ham haqiqiy sonlarmiz!» Qirol qiyin savol oldida qoladi.
style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, gentle split light — cool moonlight from the left, warm sunlight from the right — soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round king shaped like a thick, chunky upright ring with a small hole in the middle, so its wide front face is a disc. The ring is coloured like a yin-yang: the left half dark moon-silver with one small bright gold dot, the right half bright sun-gold with one small dark silver dot, the two halves curving into each other in a smooth S-shaped wave — made of polished metal, not a flat printed symbol. Big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast low-poly crystal plain, exactly where the cool left side meets the warm right side, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty low-poly crystal plain made of smooth faceted triangular polygons: cool lavender-blue facets on the left, warm amber facets on the right, blending softly in the middle. A thin glowing straight path runs across the ground from left to right through the centre. The sky is split the same gentle way: soft twilight indigo with a few stars on the left, where a pale moon with a gentle old woman's face smiles; warm morning light on the right, where a big warm sun with a kind old grandfather's face — smiling eyes, bushy eyebrows and a beard of rays — smiles back. Not dark, just a gentle difference between the two sides. No characters.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A tall, thoughtful teal character with a graceful swan-like curved neck and a flat base, gentle sad eyes, standing inside a glass cage whose front edge is shaped like a large tick-mark with a long roof (the square-root sign). Moody evening light on the low-poly crystal plain, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. An elderly scholar character with a round kind face, small spectacles and a long white beard, wearing a deep-blue chapan robe covered in a pattern of circles, holding a coil of measuring rope. He stands beside a wooden cart wheel on the low-poly crystal plain, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A lively bazaar merchant character with a curled moustache and a bright embroidered doppi cap, grinning, holding a leather coin purse that is visibly swelling and bulging with gold coins. A colourful market stall on the low-poly crystal plain behind him, front view, centred.

A strange glowing camp hidden in a deep crack in the crystal ground: colourful tents, lanterns, the caged teal character sitting on a simple throne and the elderly scholar standing beside him as vizier, many odd-looking characters around them. Keep both designs exactly the same. Vertical 9:16.

Lip-sync: only the yin-yang ring-king moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, deep, velvety storyteller's voice, slow and mysterious like an old radio fairy tale: "Ular haqiqiymi? Davomi — powerty.uz da."
